definitions.explanation: A place where two roads cross, forming four corners. Used when giving directions or describing locations in a neighborhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{四|よ}つ{角|かど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a convenience store at that intersection.
If you turn left at the next intersection, you will see the station.

notes:
USAGE:
A common word in everyday directions. Refers specifically to a four-way intersection where streets cross at roughly right angles. More colloquial and specific than ⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧, which is the general term for any intersection.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四|よ}つ{角|かど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧ (to turn at the intersection)
- {四|よ}つ{角|かど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手前|てまえ}→手前：01001_temae⟧ (just before the intersection)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧: intersection — the standard, slightly more formal term for any road crossing
- ⟦{十字路|じゅうじろ}→十字路：09387_juujiro⟧: crossroads — literally "cross-shaped road," more formal
